sentences.text:
It was submitted that though petitioner was entitled to higher compensation under consent award, without offering opportunity to avail same,
General Award was passed by Special Land Acquisition Officer (SLAO), constrained petitioner to file this writ petition.
3.

On other hand, Sri Yogesh D Naik, learned AGA for respondent no.1 and Sri H.L. Pradeep Kumar,
learned counsel for respondents no.2 and 3 would submit that petitioner had NC: 2023:KHC:44697 earlier filed writ petition challenging acquisition in W.P.no.16422/2022.

In view of same,
respondents had proceeded to pass General Award.

It was submitted that in view of earlier decision,
respondent no.3 would consider case of petitioner in accordance with law, within reasonable period.

4. Heard learned counsel and perused writ petition record.
5.
From above, in this petition neither facts nor law are disputed.

This Court under similar circumstances set-aside General Award and directed respondents to consider petitioner's case for passing consent award for failure to provide opportunity to accept compensation under consent award which was higher than under General award.
Said decision would squarely apply to this case.
6. Accordingly, Writ petition is disposed of.

General Award bearing no.KIADB/LAQ/2028/2023-24 dated 06.06.2023 at Annexure-D passed by respondent no.3 in respect of petitioner's land in Sy.no.21/7, measuring 1 Acre 15 guntas of land situated at Chapparadahalli Village, Kundana Hobli,
Devanahalli Taluk, Bangalore Rural District, is quashed.
Respondent no.3 is directed to consider petitioner's case and pass appropriate orders thereon within a period of three months.

8. Needless to observe that direction issued shall not be construed as a positive direction, but only as a direction to consider case of on its own merit in accordance with law.
9.

However, it is made clear that if there were to be any dispute relating to title of lands in question,
General Award passed shall stand revived.
Respondent no.3 is permitted to withdraw compensation, if any, deposited before Reference Court.

Sd/-
